parsed.scene_description: A blurry indoor warehouse scene with stacks of red plastic crates on wooden pallets. A forklift is visible in the background. The ceiling has fluorescent lights and structural beams. White wrapped goods are stacked to the right. The motion blur suggests movement during capture.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Stacked high on wooden pallets, occupying left and center foreground. Crates have white labels. Motion blur affects clarity. Some crates are partially obscured by others or the pallets. They rest directly on pallets.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Beneath the red crates, supporting them. Visible under crate stacks in foreground and midground. Made of wood planks. Some show wear. Direct contact with floor and crates.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Red and black vehicle in midground, slightly out of focus. Appears to be moving. Located between crate stacks. Partially occluded by surrounding crates and warehouse structure. On concrete floor.

objects.label: white wrapped goods
objects.observation: Stacked high on pallets to the far right. Wrapped in white material, possibly plastic or paper. Blurry due to motion. Resting on blue pallets. Not interacting with other objects directly.

objects.label: warehouse ceiling
objects.observation: High ceiling with exposed beams and fluorescent lighting fixtures. Lights are evenly spaced. Structural beams run horizontally. Ceiling is white and industrial. No visible attachments to walls or floor.
